ezekiel.21.p1.b1.text: I am against you, and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

ezekiel.21.p1.b3.text: Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt, and every hand will go limp. … every knee will turn to water.

ezekiel.21.p1.b4.text: A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished— it is sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning!

ezekiel.21.p1.b5.text: Cry out and wail, O son of man, … therefore strike your thigh.

ezekiel.21.p1.b6.text: I have appointed at all their gates a sword for slaughter.

ezekiel.21.p2.b1.text: Now you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take … And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city.

ezekiel.21.p2.b2.text: For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He shakes the arrows, he consults the idols, he examines the liver.

ezekiel.21.p2.b3.text: In his right hand appears the portent for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams

ezekiel.21.p2.b4.text: Remove the turban, and take off the crown. … And it will not be restored until the arrival of Him to whom it belongs, to whom I have assigned the right of judgment.

ezekiel.21.p2.b5.text: Return the sword to its sheath!
